title: config/toolchain.json
description: The toolchains that no other file of the checkout declares. Node.js is declared in .node-version, npm in packageManager of package.json, Rust in rust-toolchain.toml; php and python may also be declared in .php-version and .python-version.

php.description: The PHP minor releases that the checks run on; a patch release of a listed minor passes.

python.description: The Python minor release of the checks; a patch release of the minor passes.

pythonBuild.description: The exact Python release of the python minor, from a python-build-standalone release: install-tools installs its install_only archive for each platform in sha256, the digest of the archive from the SHA256SUMS of that release.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the archive of each platform key (process.platform-process.arch); the install reads each digest as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

pythonBackend.description: The build backend of the Python wheels: the exact requirement of the wheel, and its sha256 from the PyPI release. install-tools downloads it into var/tools/wheels with the digest checked.

composer.description: The Composer release. With sha256, install-tools installs composer.phar into var/tools; without it, the Composer of the machine is verified.

go.description: Where the Go release is declared: the go.mod that holds its toolchain line or go directive, and optionally a file that holds the exact release.

ruff.description: The ruff release that install-tools installs into a virtual environment of var/tools: the exact version, and the sha256 of the wheel of each platform key (process.platform-process.arch) that the install downloads, the digest read as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the ruff wheel of each platform key; the install accepts a wheel of any listed digest and names the platform key of none.

cargoAudit.description: The cargo-audit release that install-tools builds into var/tools/cargo-audit.

govulncheck.description: The govulncheck release that install-tools builds into var/tools/govulncheck.

node.description: The SHA-256 of the Node.js archive of the release in .node-version, for each platform that downloads it.
